questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice?
choices: The book was wrote by Shakespeare.
The book was written by Shakespeare.
The book has been write by Shakespeare.
The book were written by Shakespeare.

questions.question: In English, the present perfect can be used to describe a past action that still has a connection to the present.
Reformule la phrase suivante au discours indirect (reported speech) : She said: "I have never been to London."
Which sentence correctly uses the third conditional?
choices: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I studied harder, I would passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I study harder, I would have passed the exam.

questions.question: The modal verb "must" can express both obligation and logical deduction.
Transforme la phrase suivante à la voix passive : "Scientists have discovered a new species of bird."
Choose the sentence that correctly uses a defining relative clause.
choices: The student which won the prize is very talented.
The student who won the prize is very talented.
The student whom won the prize is very talented.
The student whose won the prize is very talented.

questions.question: In English, "used to + infinitive" is used to talk about a past habit or state that no longer exists.

exercisenotion.description: Construction et usage de la voix passive en anglais : be + past participle. Permet de mettre l'accent sur l'action plutôt que sur le sujet.
Transformation des paroles directes en discours rapporté avec les changements de temps, pronoms et expressions de temps nécessaires.
Usage des conditionnels (notamment le 3ème conditionnel) et des verbes modaux (must, should, would) pour exprimer hypothèse, obligation et déduction.
